verdict.rationale: Secureframe publishes a documented public REST API at api.secureframe.com/docs. It uses resource-oriented JSON:API endpoints with request/response schemas, embeds a full OpenAPI 3.0 definition, and documents a dated versioning policy; feature pages also describe API access to any account object and custom resources. An official MCP server further supports agent-driven use. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of API use, and a separate downloadable raw OpenAPI spec URL (the spec is only embedded in the reference page).
